class.name: FootLockModifier3D
class.brief_description: Plants feet in world space during contact phases.
class.description: [FootLockModifier3D] pins a foot at the place where it touched the ground for as long as its contact value ([member left_contact] / [member right_contact]) stays above [member plant_threshold], and runs two-bone IK on the leg (foot, its parent and grandparent) to keep it there. If the animated pose drifts further than [member max_stretch] from the planted position, the foot is released until the next lift-off. The IK weight blends in over [member blend_in] seconds and out over [member blend_out] seconds. Optionally the pelvis is lowered by the largest negative foot correction (up to 25 cm) so the lower leg can reach. Drive the contact properties from animation tracks, script or foot speed. The ground height is [member ground_height] or the result of [member ground_height_callback], called with the world X and Z as arguments.

method.name: get_foot_weight
method.description: Returns the current IK weight of a foot in [code][0, 1][/code].

method.name: is_foot_locked
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the foot is currently planted.
